confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few crowd-sourced and aggregated benchmarks (Expatistan, CultureMap, a Texas Numbeo-based study) and are treated as rough. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. The FX observation is not verified as the latest: the RBA exchange-rates page snippet I could access showed March 2026 values (0.7115, 0.7038, 0.7088 for 18, 19 and 20 March), and I used the 20 March value as the most recent one found. Third-party sites showed later values near 0.70, but they are not RBA sources. Re-check the F11.1 daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable foreign city was used. Anchors are based on Austin, Texas, with US pricing for food and drink and general US hotel and hostel levels for July.
